mapper.select: SELECT t.*, usj.subject_name AS subjectName FROM ( SELECT um.member_number AS memberNumber, um.member_id AS memberId, um.member_name AS memberName, um.member_nickname AS memberNickname, um.member_gender AS memberGender, um.member_phone AS memberPhone, um.member_type AS memberType, um.member_state AS memberState, usmtr.grad_school AS mtrGradSchool, usmtr.grad_depart AS mtrGradDepart, usmtr.grad_score AS mtrGradScore, usmte.mentee_school AS mteSchool, usmte.mentee_grade AS mteGrade, usmte.mentee_hopeuni AS mteHopeUni, usmte.mentee_hopemajor AS mteHopeMajor, COALESCE(usmtr.subject_number, usmte.subject_number) AS subjectNumber FROM UB_MEMBER um LEFT OUTER JOIN UB_SURVEY_MENTEE usmte ON um.member_type = 'MENTEE' AND um.survey_number = usmte.survey_number LEFT OUTER JOIN UB_SURVEY_MENTOR usmtr ON um.member_type = 'MENTOR' AND um.survey_number = usmtr.survey_number ) t LEFT OUTER JOIN UB_SUBJECT usj ON t.subjectNumber = usj.subject_number AND usj.subject_status = '활성' WHERE t.memberNumber = #{memberNumber}
